Tend & Harvest Rules

  • 🍽️
    Tend every 4 hours — feed & water your Gugu to keep its energy full. It's free, gas only.
  • 🧺
    Harvest 1× per day per tokenId — you can only harvest if your Gugu has been tended that day.
  • 🔥
    Streak bonus — tend 7 days in a row: harvest 1.5×. 30-day streak: harvest 2×.
  • 🌱
    Growth stages — Stage 1 unlocks at 7 tends cumulative, Stage 2 at 30 tends cumulative. Your Gugu's art changes too.
  • 🎣
    Fish 1× per day per NFT in the fishing pond — your catch is exchanged for 2–10 GGR.

Fishing not included (2–10 GGR per day). Example: a Chef with a 30-day streak harvests 20 GGR/day — 600 GGR in 30 days, excluding fishing.

Real harvests are paid by the contract from its own GGR balance. If the contract balance runs out, harvests pause until the owner refills it from royalties — no debt, no new tokens minted. GGR supply stays at 5,000,000.

Royal Fishing Pond

Every Gugu can fish once per day. Your catch is exchanged for 2–10 GGR straight to your wallet. The fish button is on each Gugu's card above — the Kingdom contract is live, so just connect your wallet to start.

An Economy Built to Last

One principle: harvests are paid from revenue, not from capital. Dev and holders alike received 10,000 GGR per NFT from the initial claim — there is no special team allocation. Daily harvests are funded by royalties and LP fees that cycle back into buying GGR.

Where harvest GGR comes from

1
Gugu sales on Element
A 5% royalty goes to the owner wallet in BNB.
▼
2
Royalty BNB buys GGR
On PancakeSwap V2 (GGR–WBNB pair), plus a 0.25% LP fee from every swap.
▼
3
GGR enters the harvest contract
An initial seed of 10,000 GGR from the dev wallet as an opening buffer.
▼
4
Holders harvest GGR
The contract only pays from its own balance — empty means it stops, it never goes into debt.

Estimated daily flow (at launch)

Royalties ±1,250 + LP fees ±200 GGR Daily harvest + fishing catch

The figures above are estimates, not promises: royalties depend on Element sales volume and LP fees on swap volume. If all 500 holders are active at once someday, payouts could exceed income — at that point the contract pays only up to its balance, and the owner can adjust rates. Harvested GGR in circulation is bought back from future royalties: the cycle is closed, supply stays fixed.
